# Shore and Oak Patrol

*The shore and the oak never stay clear. Kestrel pays for every patrol.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Fairy Forest](../towns/fairy_forest_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Kestrel](../npcs/kestrel_adventurer.md) |
| Level | 32 |
| After | [The Swarming Shore](../quests/kestrel_high_shore.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 80 Creature of the shore or the oaks ([Evil Eye](../monsters/evil_eye.md), [Curse Eye](../monsters/curse_eye.md), [Cold Eye](../monsters/cold_eye.md), [Sharpened Lupin](../monsters/sharpened_lupin.md), [Gloomfur Lupin](../monsters/gloomfur_lupin.md), [Surgeon Eye](../monsters/surgeon_eye.md))

## Rewards

- 4,152 EXP
- 960 mesos
- +15 standing with [Kestrel](../npcs/kestrel_adventurer.md)
- +20 standing with Fairy Forest

The first time you complete it instead: 8,305 EXP, 1,440 mesos, +15 standing with [Kestrel](../npcs/kestrel_adventurer.md), +30 standing with Fairy Forest
